sentences.text: The petitioners are accused Nos.1, 2 and 3.
The second respondent is the complainant, the brother of one S.Neelavathi.
The first petitioner and S.Neelavathi get married on 01.06.2017.
The relationship between the first petitioner and his wife appears to have flounder.
It transpires that on several grievances, the wife leaves the matrimonial house and begins to reside in a pay-in-guest accommodation, Bengaluru.
The averments is that the first petitioner later files M.C No.811/2019 seeking annulment of marriage.

On 15.05.2019, it transpires that the wife of the first petitioner booked a OYO room at Madiwala,
Bangalore, writes a suicide note and hangs herself in a sealing fan in a room and commits suicide.
On the incident of commission of suicide, the brother of the deceased - the second respondent then registers a complaint on 17.05.2019, which becomes a crime, in Crime No.142/2019.
The Police after investigation have filed a charge sheet before the concerned Court and on the committal, the proceedings are now pending before the learned Sessions Judge in S.C. No.339/2020.

The third petitioner - the NC: 2023:KHC:21127 father-in-law files an application before the learned Sessions Judge under Section 227 of the Cr.P.C., seeking his discharge from the array of the accused.
This is turned down by the concerned Court.
Turning down of the application leads all the accused to this Court in the subject petition.

4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would contend that the wife had left the matrimonial house long ago and there was no connection between the family and the wife of the first petitioner.
She commits suicide in a different place.
Therefore, there can be no link in the chain of events to allege the offences against the petitioners.
He would submit that the third petitioner in particular has done no wrong, for him to be an accused in the aforesaid Sessions case.
He would seek quashment of the entire proceedings.

5. On the other hand, the learned High Court Government Pleader taking this Court through the contents of the charge sheet and the statements of the witnesses, would seek to contend that, it is a matter of trial for the petitioners to come out clean.
I have given my anxious consideration to the contentions of respective learned counsel and have perused the material on record.
7. The afore-narrated facts are not in dispute.
The marriage between the first petitioner and the sister of the first informant takes place on 01.06.2017.
Grievances/allegations against the petitioners galore.
Therefore, the wife leaves the matrimonial house, does not go back to the parent's house but seeks to stay in a pay-in-guest accommodation.
On 07.02.2019, the husband files a petition before the Family Court in M.C.No.811/2019 seeking annulment of marriage.
Notice is issued on the said petition.
On 15.05.2019, it is the case of the prosecution that the wife books a OYO room and hangs herself and before so doing scribes a note.
